items.title: Why More Crypto Can Mean Less Crypto Per Treasury Share
items.summary: Selling new common shares above net asset value can increase assets per share.

items.title: Justin Sun's HTX Agrees to Leave UK in Settlement With Financial Watchdog
items.summary: The FCA says the Justin Sun-linked exchange will no longer target UK consumers, ending its first case against a crypto firm over marketing.

items.title: Treasury Sanctions 11 Over North Korean IT Worker Scheme That Moved Millions in Crypto
items.summary: Two Russian nationals converted more than $5 million in crypto for North Korean networks, according to OFAC, which listed their wallets.
